entities.name: Merit-Ptah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Merit-Ptah was thought to be a female chief physician of the king's court during the Second Dynasty of Egypt, c. 2700 BC. She was purportedly referred as such on an inscription left on her grave at Saqqara by her son.
